fusions.name: Drover's Prod
fusions.desc: Goads through a wide cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Yoke-Weight Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Horns Down
fusions.desc: 10% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you have 6% physical resistance.
